note: Every related repository at the commit this repository read it. Sessions read others only at these pins (RULES 7). Update a pin in its own PR, saying why. read_on is the date a pin was last read; copies are the rules scripts/refresh-sources.py uses to refresh reference/; watch_tags and borg_dir drive its report. A pin with a branch follows that branch instead of the default one, in its own clone vendor/<vendor>.

angband.role: The game and the original C Borg (src/borg/). The engine every Borg in the family plays; its src/borg/ is the source of the c-pristine control (T1.3).

borg-rs.role: Template for structure, tooling and external behaviour; source of the angband/ tree with the borgh harness (T1.1), the harness scripts (T1.2), engine.rs (T1.5) and the launchers and death tooling (T1.6); perception oracle (T2.5). Its commit aa4ad6c is the zoo specimen 4.2.6-rs-m0-c (pristine C Borg under borgh), the oracle for the c-pristine control (T1.3).

better-borg-c.role: C Borg with verified fixes; the baseline tag is the source of the c-bbc-m7 control (T1.3), native measurement runner, death dossiers (copied in reference/deaths/better-borg-c/).

neo-angband-tracker.role: The C Borg specification and the Tunable Borg Plan (copied in reference/c-borg/); the issue board for C Borg defects. Also the Angband Strategy Manual (docs/c-manual/ on the default branch, the complete version of S12's draft): copied in reference/c-manual/, with its copy of the official user manual.

strategy-manual.role: The Angband Strategy Manual (docs/strategy/ on the workbench/c-borg branch, not the default branch; it moved there from c-borg-reference on 2026-11-09, when c-borg-reference became pristine upstream): game mechanics, races and classes, resistances, equipment, monsters and uniques, the dungeon and a game plan by phase, grounded in Angband 4.2.6 source and lib/gamedata, with generated appendices. Game knowledge for strategy design (copied in reference/strategy/). A work in progress at the pin: chapter 3 is not yet written.

borg-zoo.role: The yardstick: suites, specimens, outcome vocabulary, the borg-rs adapter (zoo/borgrs.py) the reborn Borg and the controls must satisfy (T1.8). Design and catalogue copied in reference/zoo/.

borg-agent.role: Language-model player producing claims with evidence; its reviewed claims are inputs to strategy design (GOALS D11). Workflow template (milestones, reviewed branch).

engine_tree.note: angband/ imported from borg-rs (docs/ENGINE-TREE.md). The refresh report flags when the pin's angband/ tree differs from this tree (a re-sync is available).

c-pristine.oracle: borg-zoo 4.2.6-rs-m0-c (borg-rs aa4ad6c, impl c); harness/reference/smoke-pristine, full-pristine
c-pristine.note: The original C Borg, upstream e473720.

c-bbc-m7.oracle: none under borgh yet; overlay checked blob for blob
c-bbc-m7.note: better-borg-c milestone 7 (76 carries). The tag changes nothing outside src/borg in the engine; the only declared engine difference from better-borg-c's own build is our tree's #474 cure-all correction (wizard mode / cheat death only).
